lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੭੮॥
lines.transliteration: dehee rog na lagaee palai sabh kichh paai ||78||
lines.translation: Your body shall not suffer from any disease, and you shall obtain everything. ||78||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਖ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa pa(n)kh paraahunee dunee suhaavaa baag ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the bird is a guest in this beautiful world-garden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉਬਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਸੁਬਹ ਸਿਉ ਚਲਣ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੭੯॥
lines.transliteration: naubat vajee subah siu chalan kaa kar saaj ||79||
lines.translation: The morning drums are beating - get ready to leave! ||79||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa raat kathooree va(n)deeai sutiaa milai na bhaau ||
lines.translation: Fareed, musk is released at night. Those who are sleeping do not receive their share.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਨੈਣ ਨਂੀਦ੍ਰਾਵਲੇ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕੁਆਉ ॥੮੦॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)nhaa nain na(n)eedraavale ti(n)nhaa milan kuaau ||80||
lines.translation: Those whose eyes are heavy with sleep - how can they receive it? ||80||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ ਜਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa mai jaaniaa dukh mujh koo dukh sabaaiai jag ||
lines.translation: Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹਾ ਅਗਿ ॥੮੧॥
lines.transliteration: ooche chaR kai dekhiaa taa(n) ghar ghar ehaa ag ||81||
lines.translation: When I climbed the hill and looked around, I saw this fire in each and every home. ||81||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
lines.translation: Fareed, in the midst of this beautiful earth, there is a garden of thorns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੮੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan peer nivaajiaa ti(n)nhaa a(n)ch na laag ||82||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who are blessed by their spiritual teacher, do not suffer even a scratch. ||82||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee deh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, life is blessed and beautiful, along with the beautiful body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੮੩॥
lines.transliteration: virale keee paaeean ji(n)nhaa piaare neh ||83||
lines.translation: Only a rare few are found, who love their Beloved Lord. ||83||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਵਹਣ ਨ ਢਾਹਿ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)dhee vahan na dhaahi tau bhee lekhaa devanaa ||
lines.translation: O river, do not destroy your banks; you too will be asked to give your account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਧਰਿ ਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਹਣੁ ਤਿਦਾਊ ਗੰਉ ਕਰੇ ॥੮੪॥
lines.transliteration: jidhar rab rajaai vahan tidaaoo ga(n)u kare ||84||
lines.translation: The river flows in whatever direction the Lord orders. ||84||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਡੁਖਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਦਿਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੂਲਾਂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dukhaa setee dihu gaiaa soolaa(n) setee raat ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the day passes painfully; the night is spent in anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੜਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਬੇੜਾ ਕਪਰ ਵਾਤਿ ॥੮੫॥
lines.transliteration: khaRaa pukaare paatanee beRaa kapar vaat ||85||
lines.translation: The boatman stands up and shouts, "The boat is caught in the whirlpool!" ||85||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ ਵਹੈ ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: la(n)mee la(n)mee nadee vahai ka(n)dhee kerai het ||
lines.translation: The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇੜੇ ਨੋ ਕਪਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਪਾਤਣ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਚੇਤਿ ॥੮੬॥
lines.transliteration: beRe no kapar kiaa kare je paatan rahai suchet ||86||
lines.translation: What can the whirlpool do to the boat, if the boatman remains alert? ||86||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲਂੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ ਨ ਲਹਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa gala(n)ee s sajan veeh ik dhoo(n)dhedee na lahaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਖਾਂ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਂਲੀਹ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਿੰਨੑਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੮੭॥
lines.transliteration: dhukhaa(n) jiu maa(n)leeh kaaran ti(n)nhaa maa piree ||87||
lines.translation: I yearn for my beloved like a smouldering fire. ||87||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦੁਖੀਐ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ihu tan bhaukanaa nit nit dukheeai kaun ||
lines.translation: Fareed, this body is always barking. Who can stand this constant suffering?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਨੀ ਬੁਜੇ ਦੇ ਰਹਾਂ ਕਿਤੀ ਵਗੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥੮੮॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)nee buje de rahaa(n) kitee vagai paun ||88||
lines.translation: I have put plugs in my ears; I don't care how much the wind is blowing. ||88||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਬ ਖਜੂਰੀ ਪਕੀਆਂ ਮਾਖਿਅ ਨਈ ਵਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa rab khajooree pakeeaa(n) maakhi naee vaha(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, God's dates have ripened, and rivers of honey flow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਵੰਞੈਂ ਡੀਹੜਾ ਸੋ ਉਮਰ ਹਥ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੮੯॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo va(n)njai(n) deehaRaa so umar hath pava(n)n ||89||
lines.translation: With each passing day, your life is being stolen away. ||89||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤਲੀਆਂ ਖੂੰਡਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa tan sukaa pi(n)jar theeaa taleeaa(n) khoo(n)dahi kaag ||
lines.translation: Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰਬੁ ਨ ਬਾਹੁੜਿਓ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੯੦॥
lines.transliteration: ajai s rab na baahuRio dekh ba(n)de ke bhaag ||90||
lines.translation: Even now, God has not come to help me; behold, this is the fate of all mortal beings. ||90||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaagaa kara(n)g dha(n)dholiaa sagalaa khaaiaa maas ||
lines.translation: The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਛੁਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੯੧॥
lines.transliteration: e dui nainaa mat chhuhau pir dekhan kee aas ||91||
lines.translation: But please do not touch these eyes; I hope to see my Lord. ||91||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਾ ਚੂੰਡਿ ਨ ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਬਸੈ ਤ ਉਡਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaagaa choo(n)d na pi(n)jaraa basai ta udar jaahi ||
lines.translation: O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਿੰਜਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਤਿਦੂ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੯੨॥
lines.transliteration: jit pi(n)jarai meraa sahu vasai maas na tidoo khaahi ||92||
lines.translation: Do not eat the flesh from that skeleton, within which my Husband Lord abides. ||92||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗੋਰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਡੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਘਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa gor nimaanee sad kare nighariaa ghar aau ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the poor grave calls out, "O homeless one, come back to your home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪਰ ਮੈਥੈ ਆਵਣਾ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਨਾ ਡਰਿਆਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarapar maithai aavanaa maranahu naa dariaahu ||93||
lines.translation: You shall surely have to come to me; do not be afraid of death." ||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਲੋਇਣੀ ਦੇਖਦਿਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: enee loinee dekhadiaa ketee chal gaee ||
lines.translation: These eyes have seen a great many leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਈ ॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa lokaa(n) aapo aapanee mai aapanee paee ||94||
lines.translation: Fareed, the people have their fate, and I have mine. ||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap savaarahi mai milahi mai miliaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: God says, "If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa je too meraa hoi rahahi sabh jag teraa hoi ||95||
lines.translation: O Fareed, if you will be mine, the whole world will be yours." ||95||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਧੀ ਉਤੈ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਬੰਨੈ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)dhee utai rukhaRaa kicharak ba(n)nai dheer ||
lines.translation: How long can the tree remain implanted on the river-bank?

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਕਿਚਰੁ ਤਾਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kachai bhaa(n)dai rakheeai kichar taaee neer ||96||
lines.translation: Fareed, how long can water be kept in a soft clay pot? ||96||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਹਲ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਵਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa mahal nisakhan rahi gae vaasaa aaiaa tal ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the mansions are vacant; those who lived in them have gone to live underground.
